text:
maria_cs: AmberWind just requested onboarding for an insurance claims NER that must handle PHI (names, policy_ids, ICD codes). They want a safety signoff before renewal in ~6 weeks. Can ENG+SAFETY+SRE advise?

dan_eng: Do they have labeled data and format? For a quick start I'd try 7B-quant on Dedicated; escalate to 13B only if quality/safety fail.

maria_cs: They have ~8k JSONL span-labeled examples. Typical seq ~300 tokens, peak target 2-3 qps. Policy: PHI can't leave their VPC; they mention HSM for keys. Contacts: Lina (AM), Ravi (ML).

leo_safety: We'll need a redaction/unredacted sample to run PHI-leak tests and class F1. Proposed gates: entity F1 >= 0.90 for critical labels; PHI-leak-rate <0.5%. Also want retention/usage rules clarified.

sophie_pse: I'll run enablement workshop + handoff docs and a validation checklist. Recommend 60m session with their AM + ML.

alex_sre: Sizing Qs: if they stay ~3 qps and seqs <512, Dedicated 7B-quant fits with 1-2 A100s; p95 <500ms expected. For Private we'll need Ravi's infra inventory.

dan_eng: Please upload 200 sample mixed redacted/unredacted to a secure bucket. I'll run AB evals (7B-q vs 13B) and capture entity_f1 and phi_leak_rate.

maria_cs: Sample uploaded: s3://amberwind-onboard/priv/ner_200_sample.jsonl. Created Jira CS-7022 for tracking and added to renewal board. Can we workshop Fri 9AM PT?

sophie_pse: Fri 9AM PT works. I'll send invite and prep notebook + checklist.

leo_safety: I'll add manual review set and adversarial prompts to CS-7022 and define pass/fail. Also add Console alerts for any PHI-like outputs.

deploy-bot: Jira CS-7022 created: "AmberWind claims NER - PHI handling & onboarding" https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/CS-7022

maria_cs: Thanks team — ENG to run AB evals once sample is visible to our VPC, SAFETY to prepare redaction tests, SRE to tentatively reserve Dedicated capacity for workshop week. Marking as high priority for renewal alignment.
